channel.title: Favourite pizza?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Favourite pizza?" - Or as the nerds would say, if you opened 458, what pizza would you get?

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: A simple pepperoni or cheese pizza, also maybe some hawaiian pizza too. (sweet and savory (๑´ڡ`๑))

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded:
If there's nothing else that's interesting, regular cheese pizzas are great (especially when cold). If we're talking about really odd pizzas, though…I once ordered a pizza in Krakow that had broccoli, corn, onions, olive oil, tomatoes, pineapples, and mushrooms on it.

It was fantastic.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: Well, a pizza with edges stuffed with cheese or some other ingredient, mozzarella (many mozzarella) tomato sauce with a spicy touch, some spices this in order for add taste and smell good. A few bacon, mushrooms and maybe peppers. Then a good baking and it will be a fantastic pizza.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded:
The answer is simple, people who dislike pineapple pizza have defective tastebuds.

Close second for me is pepperoni, jalapeno, and mushroom followed by supreme(heavy on the peppers and mushrooms.)

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: I live in a land bereft of good pizza places right now and it hurts my soul. Calgary had a really nice couple of places though. One, Mannie's, went out of business after being bought and dropping in quality quite a bit. Another, Niko's, is still around, and I highly recommend it to anyone living thereabouts.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: White pizza with mozzarella and ricotta, olive oil instead of tomato sauce. Pan was seasoned with a little garlic beforehand so the flavor soaks up into the crust. Sauteed mushrooms and sun-dried tomatoes for toppings, with a hint of basil and oregano.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: Pizza with eggs,ham,chicken bits works for me everyday

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: If I opened 458, i'd have a simple pepperoni pizza. Scalding hot. I'm extremely picky with my pizzas so I stick to classics.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded:
Well, I mean, I have a weird relationship with pizza. If I were to choose, it'd largely be dependent on the day of the week. My answer is as follow:

Sunday: Definitely a Pepperoni day, but only on a thin crust.
Monday: I mean, Monday isn't really a pizza day, but if I were to get pizza, it'd likely be cheese.
Tuesday: Meat lovers! Definitely meat lovers
Wednesday: Wednesday is always a wild card, I leave no answer. It'd dependent on the mood I'm in.
Thursday: I wouldn't want pizza on a Thursday. It's such a boring day, and I'd likely want literally anything else.
Friday: Pepperoni! Easy answer!
Saturday: Extra cheese with a half pepperoni half meat lovers thingie.

Welp, theres my take!

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: Anything that has bacon or Canadian bacon, or mushrooms too.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded:
Pineapple pizza for me.
A lot of people find it weird, and I have no idea why. Maybe someone can explain it here :)

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: I unfortunately cannot eat pizza mostly (dairy and tomato sauce make me ill) but I miss a simple pepperoni and black olive pizza like no one's business :(

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded:
Note: People may dislike my pizza customization.

My favorite pizza is essentially a cheeseless version of a meat-lovers pizza. For some reason, mozzarella makes me gag so I don't eat it. Instead I'll either eat a pizza with no cheese or cheddar on it. For toppings: bacon, sausage, pepperoni, red crushed pepper, hot sauce, garlic powder and oregano. For a crust, something like a garlic & herb covered crust or even pretzel crust.

item.title: Re: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded: I personally despise basically all toppings, especially the common ones like mushrooms or pepperoni, so I just generally go with a large extra cheese pizza.

item.title: Favourite pizza?
item.content:encoded:
Title is really self explanatory, but simple! What pizza is your favourite?

In my case it'd either be BBQ pizza or hawaiian pizza. BBQ because I'm a carnivorous bastard and I love me some good old minced meat, bacon, onions and BBQ sauce combo, and hawaiian because I like the sweet-salty combo the pinneaple has and it gives me good vibes as me and my boyfriend always order it when we go out :'3
